references.text: Before this verse, the Jews describe their fear of being excommunicated from the synagogue if they confess Jesus as the Messiah, which creates the context for their aggressive rejection of the healed man.
Jesus later confirms that he is the one speaking with the man and asks whether he believes in the Son of Man, challenging the Jews' exclusivity linked to Moses.

Jesus explains that he came to judge, so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind, directly addressing the Jews' claim to be disciples of Moses while being spiritually blind.
